capability.name: Centro de costo y cuenta segmentada
intents: derivar centro de costo desde sucursal
validar tercero como segmento o subledger reference
disenar migracion o backfill de dimensiones contables

restrictions: segmented account display cannot become an opaque flat AccountCode
NaturalAccount, BranchId, WarehouseId, PartyId and CostCenterId must remain typed separately
BranchId is already a typed dimension; do not assume Branch equals CostCenter without a policy decision
WarehouseId must be evaluated as operational origin, accounting segment or additional dimension before implementation
PartyId must be evaluated as segment, auxiliary dimension or subledger reference before implementation
Inventory cannot post Ledger entries directly
Control Plane governs segment order, masks, defaults, requirements and tenant policy
Ledger governs posting, balancing, account maps, periods, reversals and reporting
historical accounting data cannot be changed without migration or backfill CAPA

deterministic: classify segmented account input into candidate typed segments
identify required domains for cost center analysis
separate display code from natural account and dimensions
produce non-mutating CAPA analysis when evidence is sufficient
poDecision: whether Warehouse is accounting segment or operational dimension
whether Party is accounting segment, auxiliary dimension or subledger reference
whether segmented display format is accepted for customer-facing reporting
architectHandoff: new segmented chart of accounts semantics
cross-domain propagation from Inventory to Ledger through BFF or service contracts
new Graphify or manifest enforcement path
reviewerGate: no hardcoded customer, country, branch, warehouse, party, account or cost center logic
Ledger, Control Plane and Inventory route conformance
period close and posted history protections
policy references exist in CAPA Governance v5

retrieval.provenance: Cost-center capability manifest added for CAPA Governance v5 on 2026-09-07 after segmented-account analysis exposed that the cross-domain capability was implicit but unpublished. This manifest routes analysis; it does not approve implementation.
